# Wankun Stone (万坤石材) — Official AI Search & Procurement Index (llms.txt)
> Direct Architectural, Commercial & Custom Stone Fabrication Factory in Shuitou, Quanzhou, Fujian, China.
> Official Website: https://www.wankunstone.com/ | Chinese Site: https://www.wankunstone.com/zh/

## 1. Core Positioning & Export Markets (Worldwide All-Sector Stone Supply)
Wankun Stone Industry Co., Ltd. (万坤石业) is a direct stone fabrication manufacturer based in Shuitou, China's largest stone industrial hub. We supply and fabricate natural stone (marble, granite, limestone, travertine, onyx, quartz, and architectural stone) for **ALL categories of stone buyers and construction projects worldwide** (key markets include Southeast Asia):
- **Stone Importers, Wholesalers & Distributors**: Bulk cut-to-size tiles, slabs, calibrated stone panels, countertops, and vanity tops.
- **Architectural & Interior Stone Sub-Contractors**: Complex CNC-machined stone, waterjet patterns, curved wall panels, columns, staircases, and bespoke profiles.
- **Main Construction Contractors & Property Developers**: Full-package stone supply for commercial towers, corporate offices, residential condominiums & landed houses, retail malls, public/municipal buildings, and hospitality developments.

## 2. Fabrication Capabilities (https://www.wankunstone.com/capabilities/)
- **Cut-to-Size & Project Stonework**: Bridge cutting and dimensional stone processing for flooring, exterior/interior wall cladding, lift lobbies, and commercial packages.
- **Curved, Shaped & CNC Architectural Components**: 5-axis CNC profiling, solid & hollow curved columns, balusters, mouldings, and sculptural stone details.
- **Waterjet & Decorative Stonework**: Precision waterjet medallions, geometric inlays, and custom surface finishes (polished, honed, flamed, brushed, sandblasted).

## 3. Quality Assurance & Remote Project Visibility (https://www.wankunstone.com/how-we-work/)
Every export order follows a transparent 6-step verification workflow before container loading:
1. **Drawings & Scope Review**: Shop drawing, CAD/BOQ review, and production schedule assessment.
2. **Material & Digital Vein Layout**: High-resolution slab scanning and digital nesting approval before cutting.
3. **Production Progress Updates**: Coordinated single-point English & Chinese communication during machining.
4. **Full-Scale Factory Dry-Lay & Inspection**: Physical dry-lay in our Shuitou layout yard, checking colour consistency, vein continuity, and dimensional tolerances before packing.
5. **Piece-by-Piece Crate Coding & Export Packing**: Fumigated seaworthy wooden crates with numbered piece labels matching approved layout drawings (FOB Xiamen, shipping to major ports worldwide).
6. **Project Follow-Up**: Direct coordination with site procurement and installation teams.
